ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 1:1.5 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large high-intensity (white) contiguous blobs occupy the distal two-thirds of both lobes, separated by a central low-intensity (black) corridor. Low-intensity linear streaks and mottling are embedded within the white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with an estimated obtuse angle of ~145 degrees and a shallow depth relative to the total fluke vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge of both lobes; pixel-amplitude varies between 3-12 pixels relative to the local edge baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory extending from the median notch to the distal lateral tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white circular clusters (rosettes) are prominent on both distal tips; sparse white micro-spots are distributed throughout the lower medial black regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of unaligned low-intensity linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white regions, with high density and near-vertical orientation on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across both lobes and significant barnacle colonization/scarring on the distal fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Irregular, high-intensity perimeter texture at the extreme lateral tips corresponding to barnacle attachment points protruding from the fluke boundary.
